key_points: Mastercard acquired BVNK for up to $1.8 B, expanding fiat‑to‑stablecoin capabilities globally.
Launched a US dollar‑pegged stablecoin consortium with Visa and Stripe, signaling deeper crypto infrastructure involvement.
Introduced AI transaction trust checks and Agent Pay for Machines to enable AI‑agent commerce.
Declared quarterly dividend of $0.87 per share, returning cash to shareholders.
Other headlines are mostly market commentary with limited thesis impact.
